description: This source file implements the interface functions for the Simple CLI Shell (SCLISH), handling session management, command processing, input handling, and communication with the terminal and underlying system components. It includes functions for accepting connections, serving commands, signaling sessions, managing session lifecycle, user authentication, and command execution.

classes.name: PSCLI_SHELL_OBJECT
classes.description: Main object representing the CLI shell, managing sessions, configuration, and communication interfaces.

classes.name: PSCLI_SHELL_SESSION_EXEC
classes.description: Represents an individual shell session, including session state, command buffers, UI elements, and related context.

classes.name: PSCLI_SHELL_PROPERTY
classes.description: Holds configurable properties for the shell, such as command cache size, greeting message, and authentication settings.

methods.name: BOOL ScliShoAccept(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hClientInfo)
methods.description: Determines if a new connection should be accepted; always returns TRUE in current implementation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoServe(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,PVOID pCmd,ULONG ulCmdSize)
methods.description: Handles incoming telnet data, processing commands, managing session states, and responding to client input.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoSignal(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,ULONG ulTspSignal)
methods.description: Handles signals such as session creation, termination, or specific commands (e.g., abort).

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE ScliShoGetSession(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG SessionId)
methods.description: Retrieves session information by session ID; creates an entry if not found.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE ScliShoCreateSession(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG SessionId)
methods.description: Creates a new shell session with initial configuration, command buffers, and UI context.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoRemoveSession(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSession)
methods.description: Removes and cleans up a session, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoStartUserAuth(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv)
methods.description: Begins user authentication process, prompting for login credentials.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoProcessCmdData(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,PVOID pCmd,ULONG ulCmdLen)
methods.description: Processes raw command data received from telnet client, handling special characters and command parsing.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoRunCmd(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv)
methods.description: Executes the current command buffer in the session, handling different session states such as username/password prompt, logged-in command processing, and special input modes.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoCacheCmd(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,PUCHAR pCmd)
methods.description: Caches a command into the session's command history buffer, managing cache size and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: BOOL ScliShoIsCmdModified(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,PUCHAR pCmd)
methods.description: Determines if the specified command differs from the command at the current cursor position in cache, used for command history navigation logic.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoRunBuiltInCmd(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,ULONG CmdCode)
methods.description: Executes predefined built-in commands such as exit, clear, help, cursor movement, etc., based on command code.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoRunNonBuiltInCmd(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,PUCHAR pCmd)
methods.description: Handles execution of external commands or user-defined commands, including command validation and permission checks.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoValidateCmdArgs(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,PUCHAR pCmd)
methods.description: Performs syntax and argument validation for the given command before execution, including argument matching and error reporting.

methods.name: ULONG ScliShoGetCmdCode(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pCmd)
methods.description: Returns a command code corresponding to the input command string, used for command dispatching.

methods.name: PUCHAR ScliShoGetPrevCmd(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession)
methods.description: Retrieves the previous command from the command cache for navigation with arrow keys.

methods.name: PUCHAR ScliShoGetNextCmd(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession)
methods.description: Retrieves the next command from cache, enabling forward navigation in command history.

methods.name: PUCHAR ScliShoGetFirstCmd(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession)
methods.description: Gets the earliest command in the cache, typically used when pressing 'up' arrow at the oldest command.

methods.name: PUCHAR ScliShoGetLastCmd(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession)
methods.description: Gets the most recent command in cache, used for command recall.

methods.name: ScliShoProcessCmdData
methods.description: Processes raw command input data received over the session, parsing escape sequences, and determining command codes.

methods.name: ULONG ScliShoGetEscCmdCode(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,PUCHAR pCmd,ULONG ulCmdLen,PULONG pulEscCodeLen)
methods.description: Interprets escape sequences (such as arrow keys or function keys) and maps them to command codes.

methods.name: ULONG ScliShoGetInputMode(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession)
methods.description: Returns the current input mode (e.g., line editing or raw mode) for a session.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoRedrawTextBoxInput(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,ULONG ulCursorTBoxPos)
methods.description: Redraws or refreshes the textbox input area, reflecting current cursor position and input buffer, optionally masking input.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoMoveToTextBox(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv)
methods.description: Moves the cursor position to the beginning of the text box input field in the terminal.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoDoAuth(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pUserName,PUCHAR pPassword,PULONG pulPerm,PBOOL pbPrivileged,PULONG pulTermPermission,PULONG pulIdleTimeout,PULONG pulLockoutTimeout)
methods.description: Performs user authentication by invoking external auth interface, verifying credentials, and obtaining permission and privilege info.

methods.name: ULONG ScliShoGetNumActiveSessions(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Returns the current number of active sessions managed by the shell.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliPostUserAuth(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,ANSC_HANDLE hShellSession,ULONG TermPermission)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoProcessCmdChar(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,UCHAR ucChar,PUCHAR pEchoBuf,PULONG pulEchoSize)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS ScliShoRunShellCmd(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSrvSession,ANSC_HANDLE hExecEnv,PUCHAR pCmd)
methods.description: unavailable
